description: This file defines an interface for plugin class loaders within the Zend Framework, specifying the methods that implementing classes must provide for managing plugin paths and loading plugins.

classes.name: Zend_Loader_PluginLoader_Interface
classes.description: Interface defining the methods for plugin class loaders, including methods for adding/removing prefix paths, checking if a plugin is loaded, retrieving class names, and loading plugins.

methods.name: addPrefixPath
methods.description: Adds prefixed paths to the registry of paths for plugin loading.

methods.name: removePrefixPath
methods.description: Removes a prefix or prefixed path from the registry of paths.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Checks whether a plugin by a specific name has been loaded.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the full class name for a given plugin name.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a plugin via the specified name.
